plate_comment: Initializes the A/C clutch control: releases logical output 0x26 (the A/C clutch request), resets the counts and the high fuel demand cutout, condition codes 5 (was protection_exception_event_26_init)

The cruise control / vehicle speed limit (road speed governor) PID, run every pass from cm848_periodicTaskSet_outputs: the reference and ramp target speeds, the speed error and its rate term, the proportional and integral (Q16) terms, the fuel demand delta into adjusted_user_fueling, the stable-speed and rate-correction timers; it presets the governor (cm848_presetCruiseAndVehicleSpeedLimitGovernor) when needed (was protectionOutputActuatorControl)

The bumpless start of the cruise / vehicle speed limit governor (also from cm848_arbitrateGovernedFueling): selects the gain zone (cm848_selectCruiseControlGainZone), sets the ramp target and reference speed (the vehicle speed limit in state 10, else the cruise command or the vehicle speed plus the droop error delta), the clamped speed error, and presets the integrator from the present fueling (was protectionRampRateControl)

Boot pass (cm848_applicationMain): the power-up cruise and road speed governor droop gains and offsets (e2m 1187), the zone code and the deadband / zone transition flags (was governorCruiseStateMachine)

Computes the cruise droop speed error delta and picks the cruise gain zone (cruise_speed_zone_code, with hysteresis on the zone thresholds) and its PID gains into cruise_pid_kp / ki / kd / rate gain working (was governor_cruise_setpoint_calc)
